title: Bride of Christ
definition: The Bride of Christ is a biblical picture of the Church as loved, cleansed, cherished, and prepared for union with Christ.
summary: The Bride of Christ reveals the Church as the beloved people Christ purifies, cherishes, and prepares for Himself.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Bridegroom who gave Himself to make His people holy and beautiful before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Bride of Christ is a biblical picture of the church as loved, cleansed, cherished, and prepared for union with Christ. Scripture uses this image to show covenant love and future glory.

The bride is not beautiful because she has no blemishes in herself. She is made ready by the Bridegroom who gave Himself to cleanse and present her holy.

Jesus loves His church with sacrificial affection. This doctrine teaches believers to see the church not only through its wounds and failures, but through Christ's redeeming purpose.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people only see the church through disappointment, hypocrisy, or hurt. The Bride of Christ does not excuse sin in the church, but it reminds believers that Jesus has not abandoned His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Love the church with holy realism: grieve sin, seek purity, and still honor what Christ loves. Let this doctrine move you toward faithfulness, patience, and hope for the Bridegroom's final day.
